capabilities.complete_execution: One geometry candidate through the existing backend, fixed task evaluation and sampled holding/profile report. No search or additional local checks. Defer/reject leaves the execution allowance unused.

instructions: Read at least one prediction view and one motion or plans view. At most two successful reading turns; independent views can be batched. Then submit a concise initial report with 2-4 facts selected using fact_handles, competing hypotheses, explicit gaps and recommendations. Use the current fact_catalog; the host resolves selectors, report.source and recommendation configuration_scope. Recommendations may defer pending a check. Do not execute or select a numerical check in this phase. Availability gaps must use inventory IDs and not_displayed, not_read, queried, not_retained or retained_unavailable; identify needed information/capability and basis. Unlisted evidence uses source plus explicit basis. Full sampled backend q/qdot is retained, even though motion shows the final window. Raw weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance without actual contributions/scaling. Diagnose this baseline replay. Geometry recommendations can be described in recommended_actions; schema recommendations may use defer when no authorized change is justified. Controller weights are outside the physical grant. Availability status applies to the entire inventory entry unless you supply update_ids (controller updates) or time_range_s (sampled backend motion). For a partially read entry, use queried and describe missing coverage, or explicitly scope a not_read/not_displayed declaration to the unread subset.

capability_gaps: No closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal attribution tool. Full trajectories are not in every request.
Existing numerical checks use a projected GVS state and bounded horizon, not a full backend replay.
inventory.claim_policy: Use inventory plus your receipt ledger: not_displayed, not_read in this context, queried with stated coverage, not_retained, or retained_unavailable through a named capability. A sampled view or failed raw gzip read does not prove absence.

memory_policy.policy: Reconstruct system instructions plus structured state; no chronological conversation replay.
memory_policy.retention: Own accepted handoff products FIFO; oversized products retain reference only. Existing recent evidence pages and last four actions stay within their original host limits. Phase changes preserve these in the same context.
memory_policy.separation: single_context shares one memory across phases; dual_context keeps one per role and receives explicit current request/report/response/feedback handoffs.

request_content.question: Open diagnostic question on the baseline replay (execution 4e358bd36ab54be3afd5003f36ff8110): the summary reports reach_passed = true with terminal_error_m 0.00764 m below reach_tolerance_m 0.01 m (handles f9b10abd95f4f, fd0407340762b), yet sampled_settling_passed = false (fc5b0de5671bc) and terminal_speed_m_s 0.635 m/s is far above the settling speed_limit_m_s 0.02 m/s (f7f96eef8a315, f6c63688b547f). (1) Within the final sampled settle window of 0.05 s (window_s f528b132fd805 / ff969064e0f03, position_limit_m 0.01 m ffb114fdfd606 / ff5fd6c07106d, speed_limit_m_s 0.02 m/s f6c63688b547f / fd8b94071611d), which measured backend tip positions and speeds exceed the limits, and how large is the exceedance? (2) How does the sampled holding position/speed profile in that window compare with the recorded late_max_error_m 0.0581 m and late_max_speed_m_s 1.5810 m/s (f5a78f2ff99df, f69887e2a8ae5), and are the one-step predictions at the last controller updates consistent with the measured tip motion at the matched endpoints (view prediction)? (3) In the computation record, what do deadline_misses = 35, mean_update_s = 17.30 s against control_period_s = 0.01 s and configured recipe horizon = 10 (f4247d77f9243, f12f519656d7c, fdcd580c300c1, f3abe564a036e) indicate about whether each update's plan was computed and applied within its interval, and does the per-update effective_horizon trace agree with the configured horizon? (4) Do the stopping counts (Solve_Succeeded 1 vs User_Requested_Stop 34; fdadd8fe6513d, f07ea946b5201) and initialization_selected 29 / noninitialization_selected 6 (fed20e2cfb7d5, f03f310fff089) indicate early or non-warm-started planning rather than a full 35-update optimized run? Treat all four as recorded observations; do not attribute a dominant cause. State explicitly whether each referenced channel was not displayed, not read in this context, not retained, or unavailable through a named capability.
scope: Retained-evidence reads only: source.* inventory entries (35 records, controller updates 0..34; one_step_predictions, applied_tensions, saved_projected_states, plan_selection, solver_status, controller_horizon, backend_motion derived views) plus the common baseline replay summary and configured controller parameters.
Report and observation only: no saved-state numerical work, no local solves or prediction evaluations (numerical_budget local_solves 0, prediction_evaluations 0).
Excluded: production configuration changes and backend execution; complete_execution capability is not exercised here (defer/reject leaves that allowance unused).
Frame note: tip vectors in world frame, projected GVS coordinates for state; a sampled view does not establish absence of unread subsets.
stopping_conditions: Stop when the sampled backend tip position/speed profile across the final 0.05 s settle window has been read for the latest controller updates and its limit exceedances are stated as observed amounts.
Stop when the terminal reach result and the sampled settling result are reported as recorded, without asserting a dominant cause or a causal link between timing and residual motion.

Stop when solver-status, plan-selection, and effective_horizon records are reported as recorded, and any unread or unretained channel is labeled not_displayed, not_read in this context, not_retained, or unavailable through a named capability.

Stop if answering would require saved-state numerical checks, closed-loop counterfactual replay, or historical full plans/optimizer traces that the inventory marks as not retained (control_snapshots.json).
request_content.subject: control

scheduling: Synchronous calls finish before fixed backend steps. Wall-clock misses do not inject simulated delay.

limitations: No historical optimizer iterations or full warm plans are reconstructed.
Single execution and model comparisons do not establish a dominant cause.
